summary: Frontend-only test of new 'Relax and Unwind' soothing-sounds section (RelaxUnwind.jsx + sounds.js) as stu-ananya (daily check-in dismissed with 'Remind me later', nothing submitted). Desktop 1920 and mobile 390 tested with an instrumented window.Audio to read real HTMLAudioElement state. Almost everything works. One real bug: once the YouTube iframe has loaded, the Escape key doesn't close the info dialog.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the info dialog. Radix auto-focuses the first focusable element in DialogContent, which is the YouTube iframe (it comes before the Close X button). Keydown events then go to the iframe's document, so Radix's Escape listener never runs. Reproduced 3/3 at 390px (activeElement=IFRAME sound-info-video; pressing Escape twice still left it open). On desktop it also failed once after hover+click. The Close (X) button and clicking outside both work.

design_issues.screen: Relax and Unwind tiles at sm+ (>=640px, e.g. 768px tablets)
issues: The info button uses sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100, so on touch tablets (no hover) it can't be seen. It is only visible on <640px phones.

passed_checks: Home: relax-unwind-section is a direct sibling right after activity-of-day-section and before calm-shorts-section (indices 3,4,5)
Toolkit: relax-unwind-section is the nextElementSibling of activity-of-day-section
15 tiles in the correct order (guitar..thunderstorm). Grid has 5 columns on desktop (140px each) and 3 columns on 390px. Background photo loads (unsplash 200)
All 15 jukehost audio URLs return 206 audio/mpeg
Play: data-playing=true, white ring, spinner sound-loading-<id> seen, then 3 animated bars. Toast '<Name> playing'. Audio not paused and currentTime increased (5.02 -> 6.5 -> 12.2s)
Quick double tap (play, then pause while loading) ends paused/inactive, with no error toast
3 sounds mixed at once (guitar, rain, waves) all advancing. Stop all showed (3), then (2) after pausing rain. Stop all paused every audio and the button went away
Volume slider only on active tiles. fill(20) set volume to 0.2 and a mouse click on the slider set it to 0.89 without toggling playback (data-playing stays true)
Info dialog: title, 'By: Meditative Mind', description, 4 tags, YouTube embed iframe src youtube.com/embed/53WVdC6IUjA. Opening info did not change playback. Closing with X works
No orphan playback: no audio playing after Home->Insights, Toolkit->Home or logout
390px: no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth 390). All labels including 'Thunderstorm' (73px in a 96px tile) fit and are readable on the photo
No console errors in any run
action_items: Fix Escape-to-close in sound-info-dialog: add onOpenAutoFocus={(e) => e.preventDefault()} to the DialogContent, or move focus to the close button or title, so the iframe doesn't take keyboard focus on open
Optional: make the info button visible on touch devices at sm+ (e.g. [@media(hover:hover)]:sm:opacity-0), or always show it at low opacity
critical_code_review_comments: RelaxUnwind toggle(): if the user pauses while play() is still pending, the promise rejects with AbortError and the catch shows a 'Couldn't play' error toast. Not seen in testing, but it is possible on slow networks. Ignore AbortError (e.name === 'AbortError') in the catch.
Unmount cleanup sets a.src='' and that can fire an 'error'/'emptied' event. Harmless now, but a.removeAttribute('src'); a.load() is the cleaner way to release.
stopAll gives no toast feedback. Fine, just inconsistent with play/pause.
seed_data_creation: None. Daily check-in was dismissed with 'Remind me later' and nothing was submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To check audio, use page.add_init_script that wraps window.Audio and pushes instances to window.__audios, then call page.goto(url) again so the script applies. The info button is hover-only at >=640px, so hover the tile (or use force=True) before clicking sound-info-<id>. Close the dialog with the 'Close' button inside sound-info-dialog, because Escape fails while the iframe has focus.
